title: Scala Rove Boots
description:
• SCALA ROVE BOOTS  SCALA ROVE BOOTS are engineered for superior protection, all-weather performance, and all-day comfort, combining premium materials with advanced rider-focused safety features. Featuring reinforced toe, heel, ankle, and shin protection, a Hydratec™ waterproof & breathable membrane, and a proprietary all-terrain sole, the ROVE Boots are built to keep you protected, comfortable, and confident on every ride. .

Category Description
Reinforced Toe Box
  • The front section of the boot features a hardened protective layer that shields your toes from impact and compression, offering enhanced safety in case of sudden stops or drops.
Gear Shift Protection Panel
  • A specially designed abrasion-resistant overlay at the gear contact zone ensures your boots maintain their premium look, even after repeated use.
Shock-Absorbing Heel Support
  • A reinforced heel structure provides additional protection against impacts while enhancing foot stability, especially during long rides or rough terrain.
Malleolus (Ankle Bone) Protection
  • Integrated padding around the ankle bone area helps protect against side impacts and abrasions, a vital safety feature for any rider.
Extended Shin Padding
  • Reinforced shin panels offer superior coverage for the lower leg, reducing the risk of injury from flying debris or frontal impacts.
Waterproof Treated Leather
  • Crafted from top-grade full-grain leather treated to resist water penetration, ensuring your feet stay dry and the boot maintains its durability in all conditions.
Hydratec™ Waterproof & Breathable Membrane
  • This inner lining creates a sealed waterproof barrier while allowing moisture and sweat to escape, keeping your feet dry and comfortable no matter the climate.
YKK® Zippers
  • Trusted worldwide for their strength and reliability, our boots are equipped with premium YKK zippers for smooth operation and long-term durability.
Dual Adjustable Velcro Straps
  • Located at the ankle and upper calf, these straps allow for a secure and customizable fit, enhancing comfort while riding and walking.
Proprietary All-Terrain Sole
  • Designed with a raised groove pattern for superior grip, this custom sole deliver adventure-grade traction while maintaining a sleek, semi-formal aesthetic suitable for urban wear.
Ortholite® Comfort Insole
  • Built-in Ortholite insoles provide exceptional cushioning, breathability, and moisture-wicking performance — ideal for all-day riding comfort.

title: Scala Hydra-seal Rain Pants (Black Neon)
description:
• Hydra-seal Technology: Ensures complete waterproof protection, keeping riders dry even during the heaviest monsoon downpours.
  • Seam-Sealed Construction: Fully tape-sealed seams prevent water seepage, delivering reliable anti-leak performance in extreme rain conditions.
  • High-Visibility Design: Black rain pants with strategically placed neon panels enhance visibility without compromising the premium riding look.
  • Reflective Safety: Reflective detailing improves rider visibility during night rides, rain, fog, and other low-light conditions for enhanced safety.
  • Lightweight & Packable: Made from lightweight materials that fold into a compact size, making it easy to carry on every ride.
  • Built for Every Ride: Ideal for long-distance touring and daily commuting, providing dependable all-weather protection in every riding condition.
Product Features
The Scala Hydra Seal Rain Pant is crafted from premium waterproof fabric that keeps riders dry and comfortable throughout heavy Indian monsoon rides.
Its fully seam-sealed construction prevents water from entering through stitched areas, ensuring complete leak-proof performance.
Designed in a sleek black finish with high-visibility neon panels, the pant offers improved daytime visibility while maintaining a stylish riding appearance.

Reflective elements are strategically positioned to enhance rider visibility during night rides and adverse weather conditions.

The lightweight construction allows the pant to be folded into a compact size, making it easy to store in a backpack, top box, or motorcycle luggage.

Designed for touring enthusiasts as well as everyday commuters, the Scala Hydra Seal Rain Pant delivers dependable waterproof protection, enhanced visibility, and lasting comfort on every ride.

title: Scala Air Glove - Black
description:
• Ultra-Light Design: The Scala Air Gloves are our lightest gloves yet, offering an unparalleled lightweight experience without compromising on durability.

  • Superior Ventilation: Best-in-class ventilation ensures maximum breathability, keeping your hands cool and comfortable even during long rides.

  • Top-Notch Protection: Designed to provide excellent protection, the Air Gloves feature robust materials and construction, safeguarding your hands on every journey.

  • Versatile Use: Perfect for both city commutes and highway rides, these gloves adapt to various riding conditions, offering flexibility and comfort.

  • Enhanced Agility: Experience unmatched agility with these gloves, allowing for precise control and maneuverability, essential for urban exploration and long-distance cruising.

  • Ultimate Comfort: Gear up with the Scala Air Gloves and enjoy a new level of comfort on your rides, thanks to their ergonomic design and breathable fabric.

SCALA-AIR Gloves
The SCALA-AIR gloves keep protection and style in focus. The 100% poly stretch fabric and 100% polyester air mesh keep the glove well-ventilated all through the ride. It comes with TPR rubber knuckle protection and takes it a notch above by adding the feature at the back too. With TPR addition at both, front and back, the gloves provide enhanced protection at all times. The microsuede patch on the palm enables solid grip and a sponge at the palm area reinforces the grip with comfort.
PRODUCT FEATURES:
Protection
  • Enhanced protection due to TPR knuckle protectors at front with SCALA logo
  • Rubber molded protection on fingers
Construction
  • 100% poly stretch fabric and 100% polyester air mesh
Comfort
  • Soft, flexible comfortable mesh panels
  • Ventilated with air mesh material for heat control
  • Microsuede for better grip
  • Consists of a 3mm rubber sponge for palm reinforcement
  • PR strap with Velcro to keep it from slipping
Features
  • For mobile operations, touch screen friendly Tap Fingertips available on the index fingers.

title: Scala FLEX Kneepads
description:
• SCALA GEAR FLEX  Kneepad are engineered for superior protection, comfort, and breathability, combining innovative design with top-tier safety features. Featuring advanced pivoting systems, full coverage, and CE-certified impact protection, SCALA GEAR Kneepad are designed for a natural fit that moves seamlessly with your body, whether on the job or in action-packed environments.

Category Description
Safety
  • CE Certified Impact Protection: Certified to EN 1621-1:2012, Level 1 for knee and shin protection.
  • High-Strength Materials: Constructed with high-density Polypropylene (PP), HDPE, and washable foam.
  • Full Knee & Shin Coverage: Provides protection for knee, sides, and shin, even when fully bent.
Comfort & Fit
  • Dual Axis Pivot Design: Anatomically designed pivot points synchronize with natural knee movement.
  • 3D Molded Foam Backing: High-density foam backing ensures a secure fit, improved ventilation, and impact protection.
  • Sweat-Wicking Technology: Absorbs sweat and moisture to keep the user cool and comfortable.
  • Asymmetric Design: Specially developed for a personalized fit based on the natural curvature of the knee.
Ventilation & Breathability
  • Mesh Ventilation System: Equipped with strategically placed vents for continuous airflow.
  • Breathable Foam Backing: Foam with mesh panels ensures comfort and ventilation during intense activity.
Durability & Ease of Use
  • Low-Profile, Lightweight Design: Weighs only 850 grams per pair, offering maximum protection without sacrificing mobility.
  • Hard Shell Slider: Polypropylene shell with a friction-free finish, ideal for various activities.
  • Pivoting Shells: Anti-scratch pivot shells reduce wear and tear while enhancing flexibility and comfort.
  • Counterbored Screw Rivets: Soft rounded screw rivets minimize scratches and damage to surfaces.
Versatile and Convenient
  • Easy On/Off: Intuitive girth adjustment allows for quick and easy use.
  • Universal Fit: One size fits all with adjustable straps for a custom fit.
  • Over/Under Pant Compatibility: Can be worn over or under pants for added versatility.
  • Easy Maintenance: Foam backing is semi-removable for easy rinsing and cleaning.

title: Scala Viper Glove - Black Neon
description:
The SCALA -VIPER Gloves protect you from the terrain, while still being comfortable to wear over long distances. With SAS-TEC – LEVEL -2 (Germany) protectors and KNOX® patented Sport SPS-UK, an outer shell made from highly abrasion-resistant genuine leather, our Short Riding Gloves come ready for adventures, out of the box.

  • Enhanced Protection: Fortified with SAS TEC-LEVEL-2 Protection, providing advanced safety for every ride.

  • Improved Fit: Experience an all-new fit designed for maximum comfort and flexibility.

  • KNOX® Sport SPS: Equipped with patented Sport SPS for smooth sliding upon ground contact, minimizing wrist hyper-extension risks.

  • Versatile Design: Refreshed design combines style and resilience, perfect for various riding conditions.

  • Durability: Built to withstand the demands of adventure, ensuring long-lasting performance.

  • Confident Riding: Gear up confidently with the Viper Gloves, your indispensable partner for every journey.

Impact Protection
  • SAS-TEC – LEVEL -2 protectors (Germany) at knuckles
  • KNOX® Patented Sport SPS-301 (Scaphoid Protection System-UK)
Construction
  • Made from 100% highly abrasion-resistant genuine leather.
  • Cuff length, adventure touring fit.
  • Micro dots of silicone bonded to the leather, which increases the grip and lengthens the life of the leather.
Comfort
  • Cuff length, adventure touring fit.
  • Ribbed stretch panels on finger joints.
  • Pre-curved fingers for better fit.

  • Adjustable Velcro tab.
Features

  • Nicely placed soft viper on the left hand, which helps to keep clean the helmet visor in rainy season.
  • Touch screen friendly Tap Fingertips available on the index fingers for mobile operation.
